Notes & troubleshooting
This is targeted to the Spotify Web Player (open.spotify.com). If you want it to apply to play.spotify.com or another URL, change the Applies to field in Stylish accordingly.

Spotify updates class names and markup sometimes. If a rule stops working, open Developer Tools (F12), inspect the element you want to change, and either:

adjust the selector in the style (I can help if you paste the element HTML), or
